on Thursday that it appointed Sanjay Subramanian as CFO, effective September 9, following the retirement of Ivor Macleod
Subramanian has more than 20 years of experience in finance, capital markets, and business development across the biotech, pharmaceutical, and healthcare sectors.
He most recently served as CFO and Head of Business Development at Inozyme Pharma, where he helped lead its acquisition by BioMarin Pharmaceutical.
The company granted him an option to purchase 100,000 SCYNEXIS shares at an exercise price of $4.91 per share, with four-year vesting and a 10-year term, pursuant to the Inducement Award Plan.

title: SCYNEXIS appoints Sanjay Subramanian as CFO
